# Owner seat increase notice

Owners asked for this after the September pricing change — see the support thread.

## Problem

**Actor & trigger**: an org owner adds a seat — the org is billed per seat.

## Deliverables

### D1 — Seat notice email

Email the owner when a seat is added — include the Per-Seat
price and the date it takes effect.

### D2 — Audit row

Record every seat change — who, when, and the new total.
